dedupe_keys.name: great britain primary substations with household heating context

description: This collection links Great Britain’s primary substations to firm capacity, peak demand, location and parent grid-supply point. The research team standardizes six distribution operators’ files and adds household central-heating counts through spatial linkage to census areas. England and Wales use the 2021 census; Scotland uses 2011 data in this release. Zenodo archives version 1.0.2 under CC BY 4.0, while the live GitHub repository, now yihong-zhou/Data-PS-GB, states GPL-3.0 and includes CSV outputs and processing notebooks. Both are publicly accessible without charge. Coverage excludes Northern Ireland. Spatially inferred service areas and differing source dates limit interpretation of headroom and household-to-substation assignment. A reviewer-assessed use is evaluating heat-pump, vehicle-charging or data-centre connection scenarios. model-pandapower is a related network tool, but aggregate substation information does not define a complete power-flow circuit. No archived files or notebooks were downloaded or executed.
